SarkariFormStudio vendors `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 1.1.0 and its FaceLandmarker model.

- Package license: Apache-2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)
- Package source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision
- Model source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
- Model license: Apache-2.0

The package and model are distributed unmodified. The package's upstream version and model SHA-256 are pinned in `package.json` and `data/model-manifest.js`; the generated asset digest list is in `vendor/models/manifest.json`.
